audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant `legionFee + referrerFee + projectAmount == totalRaisedCapital` holds by construction: `projectAmount` is explicitly computed as `_totalCapitalRaised - legionFee - referrerFee`, making the sum an algebraic identity. Both `LegionCapitalRaise` and `LegionAbstractSale` use this remainder pattern; integer division (floor) on fee terms only makes them smaller, ensuring no undercount of the project share. If fees were configured to exceed 100% (no cap exists in `_verifyValidConfig`), Solidity 0.8 checked arithmetic would revert the transaction rather than silently violate the invariant.
